description:
24 Summerstown Grove, Glasheen, Cork.

A Stunning 4-Bed Family Home in the Heart of Glasheen

Set in one of Cork's most sought-after addresses, just moments from Cork University Hospital and UCC, this beautifully renovated four-bedroom, three-bathroom home is ready to move straight into.

Thoughtfully extended to the rear, the property now boasts a bright, spacious dining area — perfect for entertaining or everyday family life. Finished to a high standard throughout, this home combines style, comfort, and versatility.

Ground Floor
A welcoming sitting room leads through to a well-appointed kitchen and separate dining room, ideal for family life and entertaining. Also on this level is bedroom 4, complete with its own ensuite — offering flexible living, perfect for multigenerational households, guests, or a private home office. A separate shower room and a generous utility room complete this floor, adding further practicality to the home's polished finish.

First Floor
Bedrooms 1, 2 and 3 — all well-proportioned — along with a family bathroom, provide comfortable accommodation for the rest of the family.

Outside
A driveway to the front offers convenient off-street parking, while a private patio to the rear is perfect for outdoor dining and relaxing. The property enjoys a wonderful outlook, facing directly onto a large green area.
